deviations.what: Add t21: members advertise split-brain, memory and tunnel evidence (gateway /capabilities spans/world_size from operator-typed <PREFIX>_SPANS/_WORLD_SIZE; /health memory from /proc/meminfo and a declared LOBES_TUNNEL_PUBLIC_URL), and the site reads them for remote members
deviations.reason: Live probe 2026-11-09: no gateway advertises world_size/spans, memory or a tunnel, so t17's never-guess rule renders the TensorFold GLM cortex (spark+spark2) as single, peer memory as unknown and no remote hub; t20's success signal (1 split brain) cannot pass. Operator chose option (a) over softening t20.

deviations.what: Amend d1 (t21): split-brain and hub evidence are read from the running system, not hand-defined. Drop <PREFIX>_SPANS, <PREFIX>_WORLD_SIZE and LOBES_TUNNEL_PUBLIC_URL; the site derives a split from each resident's serving containers (allowlisted world/rank config, e.g. TensorFold TF_*_WORLD/TF_*_RANK, read over the residents' SSH) and the hub from the member actually running lobes-cloudflared. /health memory (measured) stays.
deviations.reason: Operator review 2026-11-10: the site must read how the system is set, not hand-typed declarations that can drift. Live: glm53-spark TensorFold containers carry TF_GLM_WORLD=2 with rank 1 on spark and rank 0 on spark2; the engine's /health and /v1/models do not expose world/rank, and the gateway cannot see container env.
